name: Ice-cube hover
description: The product frozen inside a clear ice cube on a wet slate slab, cool rim light, studio macro. Needs one product image. Good for drinks, skincare and anything that should read as cold.
prompt: Product photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, frozen inside a crystal-clear ice cube resting on a wet dark slate slab. Macro lens, cool blue rim light from behind, soft white key from the front, tiny bubbles in the ice, condensation on the slab. {{#if extra}}{{ extra }}.{{/if}} No text, no extra objects.
negative_prompt: warped label, extra products, text, hands, watermark
author: kilnry
